content: Increment 2b: mechanize S_B as a big-step STATE TRANSFORMER (bodyDenote/blockThread/stmtDenote) over the frozen straight-line Stmt/Block forms (letS/assign/exprS/ifElse/seq/tail) in lean/Thermite/Exec/Stmt.lean (namespace Thermite.Exec). Reuse 2a's ExecExpr/execDenote/ExecVal/ExecEnv for every per-RHS / condition / tail value; add ONLY the state threading + scalar-cell mutation rebind + branch composition + tail projection. Model body_ref_state's operational threading as bodyRefState (independent, via execRefValue) and prove theorem body_ref_sound by lifting exec_ref_sound through the threading. Faithful to exec_stmt_encode.rs::body_ref_state (scalar mutation only; xs[i]=e + loops + mid-body return are Unsupported = honestly OUT, 2c #163). 3 negative lemmas: wrong-var assign, sequencing-order, mutation-not-applied. lake build green, axioms propext/Quot.sound only, no sorry.
